renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium work-pressure shared-world guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the two named guardians or canonical internal pair from the approved source and no third guardian, coworker, manager, client, recipient, human, silhouette, reflection, body clue, empty seat or personal belonging implying another person. Preserve both canonical identities, relative size/colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes with exactly one large plus one small highlight in each visible eye, and visible chest Stella stars. The pair plus one shared pressure-control system covers 55–65% and remains readable at actual width 80px. Give each guardian one independent boundary action or role control and keep a visible open handoff zone; never imply hierarchy, compulsory care, unanimous agreement, inevitable burnout, failure, punishment or guaranteed coping success. Written work surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, handwriting lines, names, labels, score, number, date, clock face, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Every cover, plate, clip, divider, sleeve, gate, token, line, clamp or connector remains removable, half-set, open-ended or still adjustable. Libra may use exactly one abstract meeting balance; no other sign uses a scale. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart tip is allowed; no added heart or heart-shaped light/void. No closed ring, halo, portal, infinity sign, deterministic route or completed coping emblem. Keep every composition distinct in pair axis, pressure source, role boundary, focal-system silhouette and open negative-space shape. Follow compositionFamily, artDirection, distinctFrom and visualReviewFocus literally. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, visible paper grain, rounded plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
